# components of all !=7 with 4-connectivity
from collections import deque

def comps(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]==7 or (r,c) in seen: continue
   q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
    for nx,ny in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
     if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   vals=sorted(set(grid[x][y] for x,y in cells if grid[x][y] not in (0,7)))
   out.append((min(x for x,y in cells),min(y for x,y in cells),max(x for x,y in cells),max(y for x,y in cells),len(cells),vals))
 return out
comps(grid3)
